title: 30A Mojo | 5BR Rental on Seagrove Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 30A Mojo is a signature 5BR Seagrove Beach villa featuring Gulf views and a private pool. This luxury rental sleeps 12 by Royal Destinations on 30A.
description_expanded: Description: 30A Mojo by Royal Destinations Location: Old Seagrove Beach Address: 2669 East County Highway 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Located directly across from the beach access, this beautiful custom built villa features Gulf views, a private pool with screened in porch, and beautiful interior design. Just a short walk away from Seaside, 30A Mojo (formerly St. Somewhere) offers an array of activities for you to choose from. From the moment you pull up, you will be welcomed by the beautiful landscaping, cobble stone driveway, beautiful trees steps from the white sands and turquoise waters. 30A Mojo boasts all the amenities for the most discerning of guests. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Beach Access is Across from Home (105 Feet or 1-Minute Walk) - 4 Adult Bikes Provided - Outdoor Shower - Coastal Chic Decor - Open Kitchen and Living Room Area - Screened in Porch - Flat Screen TVs in Every Room - Linens Provided - Sub Zero Kitchen Appliances - Elevator* *The elevator is available for an additional $150 (pre-tax). *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. - Private (Heated) Pool and Jetted Spa* *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (En Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2: Bunk Room with Two Twin/Twin Bunks with Stair Access and Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Family Room, Wet Bar -Lanai, Pool, Pathway to Beach Access Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: (En Suite Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Great Room, Kitchen, Spacious Deck with Fountains -Powder Room -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: (En Suite Master) King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 5: Queen Bed Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
